change: Open-ended signed-word stepped counters in combined and/or headers, conditions and comprehensions; reuse bounded range counting internally and panic only when another exhausted value is requested.
independent_c_gate: 4388 passed in 85.18s with two workers, after three bootstrap generations
coverage: Native/web and default/release: ascending/descending counters, finite partners, conditions, continue/break, comprehensions, fallback, source-order bound evaluation, optional or values, full signed-domain strides, zero-step and overflow errors.
limits: Combined stepped counters use signed int64, like bounded combined/stored ranges. Standalone range loops keep their existing integer-width inference. Stored open ranges remain unsupported.
rejected_experiments: Before this change, cached stable-vreg predicates and reordered CSE validity checks were benchmarked over seven alternating pairs. Neither improved overall compilation convincingly; all production changes were removed.
